name: Raleigh Sheet Metal
old_description: Raleigh Sheet Metal is a leading metal fabrication company in Raleigh, NC, providing top-quality services to commercial clients throughout the Triangle since 1981. We specialize in servicing the glass storefront industry, offering a full range of metal fabrication services including shaping for roofing and siding needs. Our team of experienced professionals is dedicated to delivering superior results and exceptional customer service. We use the latest equipment and techniques to ensure precision and accuracy in every project we undertake.
about:
Raleigh Sheet Metal operates from Raleigh, North Carolina, and has served commercial clients across the Triangle region since 1981. The business traces its roots to Terry Phillips, a third-generation tin man described as a perfectionist and sheet metal artist, though the company does not formally disclose its ownership structure.

The shop provides a full range of sheet metal fabrication services, with a focus on shaping components for glass storefronts, roofing, and siding. Work is performed using modern equipment and techniques, though the company does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Primary customers are commercial contractors and building owners in the Raleigh-Durham-Chapel Hill area who need custom metalwork for storefront systems, roof edges, and siding details. The company does not name specific clients in its public materials.

Raleigh Sheet Metal emphasizes reliability, professionalism, and customized solutions delivered on time and within budget. Its reputation rests on precision workmanship—summarized in a customer quote: “When it absolutely has to be perfect, there is no other”—and on the craft knowledge passed through three generations of the Phillips family.
